newsitem.title: USA: MacroChem gel 67-75 pct successful in study.
newsitem.headline: MacroChem gel 67-75 pct successful in study.

text.p: MacroChem Corp said Tuesday its gel for the treatment of erectile dysfunction, called SEPA/alprostadil, was 67 to 75 percent sucessful in clinical trials.
MacroChem said Lehman Brothers is helping it identify pharmaceutical companies appropriate for licensing and marketing the product.

MacroChem said the study compared three dose levels of the gel to a placebo. Each patient received a single application of gel, and erectile responses were measured over a one and one-half hour period following dosing.
Forty-eight patients with clinically confirmed erectile dysfunction entered and completed the study.
No serious adverse events were reported in the study.
